steps.note: Confirmation shown before anything ran (Hand to You?StartNot now | Send this task? Send the instruction for Add a stock-to-watch section to the weekly brief to Claude Code using its selected model and). 1 row in Working while it ran; session Sdfd20bc5cc27 on route claude-code, model not recorded, ended failed after 15 s. Board after: Blocked 1. 9 History entries, last: Work stopped: The engine did not return a valid file proposal. No files were changed. Start again to request a new proposal. No project files were changed.

steps.name: 17-ask-for-one-revision
steps.note: Revision sent from the thread composer on the claude-code route. Reply recorded from assistant via claude-code, model not recorded: "No documents were supplied with this request, so I have no source material to draw a brief from or to keep source markers for. Please provide the document(s) containing the brief you'd like shortened." The composer sends the instruction with no confirmation of its own, unlike the Board's Start, and in ask mode it carries no project document with it. The brief itself is deterministic, so a revision of it is a model turn about a document no model wrote.

backendPreparation: GET /api/ai/status — read back what the setup screen reported, for the record.
GET /api/settings — verified the selection the screen claimed to save.
GET /api/projects — read the created project id for later verification.
POST /api/projects/:id/documents/create bakery-weekly-sales.csv — the two fictional exports, because no attachment control exists.
POST /api/projects/:id/documents/create bakery-inventory.md — the two fictional exports, because no attachment control exists.
GET /api/workspace — read the organization id for later verification.
GET /api/workspace/questions and .../setup — read the question schema and the current step so the answers below could be typed into the screen’s own controls.
GET /api/workspace/organizations/:id/configuration — verified the activation the screen claimed.
POST /api/projects/:id/documents/create weekly-operations-exports — the one path the active setup names, written so the brief has something to read.
GET /api/projects/:id/documents/read — read the drafted brief back to check its source list.
POST /api/projects/:id/tasks — created the task, because no Console control creates one.
GET /api/projects/:id/state — read sessions and History to check what the Board showed.
GET /api/projects, /state and /documents after the relaunch — verified the work the reopened window showed.
limitations: The approved-export selection is fixed by the pack variant to ["weekly-operations-exports"]; no screen lets a person name which exports the brief reads.

The weekly brief can be prepared once per project. WeeklyBriefService.run passes the previous file text as the recorded writer's `expected` value, which store.writeRecorded compares against a sha256, so every later run is refused with "This document changed since you opened it."
